name: us-form-1120-s-s-corporation-return
description: Prepare Form 1120-S, the US income tax return for an S corporation, for tax year 2026. Covers who must file, the 15 March 2027 due date for a calendar year, Schedule K-1 furnished to each shareholder, stock-basis adjustments under section 1367, distributions under section 1368, the 21 percent built-in gains tax and the five-year recognition period, the excess net passive income tax, and the section 6699 late-filing penalty of USD 260 per shareholder per month for a return required to be filed in 2027. Does not decide whether to elect S status and does not compute the shareholder loss limits. Trigger on "Form 1120-S", "S corporation return", "Schedule K-1 1120-S", "built-in gains tax", "S corp due date", "AAA". Federal only.
